obligations.expected_behavior: Replay, seed, matrix, review, and Quick Dev artifacts expose an empty authorization set in a machine-verifiable form.
forbidden_result: Any named artifact exposes a non-empty machine-verifiable authorization set.
obligations.observable_result: Each named artifact reports a machine-verifiable authorization set containing zero entries.
obligations.state_after: The authorization set exposed by every named artifact is empty and machine-verifiable.
obligations.state_before: The named artifacts are exposed before their authorization sets are verified.
obligations.subject: Replay, seed, matrix, review, and Quick Dev artifacts
obligations.trigger: When these artifacts expose their authorization data.

obligations.expected_behavior: Enforce that only the current Acceptance lifecycle owner may publish an acceptance-passed result.
forbidden_result: An actor who is not the current Acceptance lifecycle owner publishes acceptance-passed.
obligations.observable_result: Publication of acceptance-passed is authorized only for the current Acceptance lifecycle owner; other actors are denied.
obligations.state_after: Acceptance-passed publication is restricted to the current Acceptance lifecycle owner.
obligations.state_before: An actor attempts to publish acceptance-passed and ownership authorization has not yet been applied.
obligations.subject: Acceptance-passed publication authorization
obligations.trigger: When any actor attempts to publish acceptance-passed.
